name: Amineptine
summary: Amineptine, formerly sold under the brand name Survector among others, is an atypical antidepressant of the tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) family. It acts as a selective and mixed dopamine reuptake inhibitor and releasing agent, and to a lesser extent as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Amineptine inhibits the reuptake of dopamine and, to a much lesser extent, of norepinephrine. In addition, it has been found to induce the release of dopamine. However, amineptine is much less efficacious as a dopamine releasing agent relative to D-amphetamine, and the drug appears to act predominantly as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Amineptine was approved in France for severe clinical depression of endogenous origin in 1978.

summaryZhHans: 阿米庚酸，又名安咪奈丁、氨奈普汀、安扑丁，是一种具有三环类抗抑郁药结构的非典型抗抑郁药。其作用机理主要是作为选择性和混合性多巴胺再摄取抑制剂及释放剂，及一种较弱的去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂而起作用。
